entries.text: A regulation-page check detects access and changes, not permission to fish. Harbor information is not live entrance clearance.
Captains named “ X ”; they did not publish GPS positions or fishing depths. Purple shows our approximate search water, not a boat track or a confirmed reef.
Outline survey depths X ft X · MLLW
AIS does not cover every boat; detection and classification errors remain possible. Apparent fishing effort is not proof of fishing or catches.
Street map tiles are not saved; OpenStreetMap does not allow bulk downloads. Planning aid · not a navigation chart.
Essential habitat is not a hotspot. The app does not assign a tuna school to a management polygon.
It is presented as dated context, not mapped as a present hotspot. Named features such as White Rocks must not be confused with a similarly named reef near Cayucos.
They are not a local adult-Chinook catch-temperature model. Freshwater spawning or egg-survival temperatures are not used as ocean-fishing targets.
This file does not update offline. The planned date is a label, not a future clearance.
